sitewide.translation_message: This application is translated by users like you! If you see items that are not translated (or have suggestions for improvements!) please suggest improvements on GitHub.

controller_actions.description: Perform maintenance actions on the controller
controller_actions.warning: These actions will interrupt temperature control. The controller will restart after each action.
controller_actions.confirm_restart_msg: The controller will restart. Temperature control will be interrupted briefly.
controller_actions.confirm_reset_connection_msg: WiFi connection will be reset and the controller will restart. You may need to reconnect to this device.
controller_actions.confirm_reset_config_msg: All configuration will be reset to factory defaults. This cannot be undone. You will need to reconfigure the controller.
controller_actions.action_triggered_msg: The controller is restarting. This page may become unresponsive for a few moments.
controller_actions.action_failed_msg: Unable to send action to the controller. Please check the connection and try again.
controller_actions._comment_clear_glycol_log: TODO: REMOVE BEFORE FINAL RELEASE - clear_glycol_log translations below
controller_actions.confirm_clear_glycol_log_msg: This will clear the on-device glycol log. This action cannot be undone.

temp_units_change.update_failed_msg: Unable to connect to the controller or the update was rejected. Please try again.

mode_change.beer_profile_switch_warning: Controller is currently in beer profile mode, which implies that it is being managed elsewhere. Mode changes here may interrupt the beer profile, or may be overwritten back to beer profile mode on next sync.
mode_change.update_failed_msg: Unable to connect to the controller or the update was rejected. Please check the information provided and reattempt to update.

assign_sensor_modal.already_exists_error: A device with this function already exists. If you continue, it will be removed.
assign_sensor_modal.calibration_offset_rounding_note: Note - Calibration will be rounded to nearest 1/16° C
assign_sensor_modal.update_failed_note: Unable to connect to the controller or the update was rejected. Please check the information provided and reattempt to update.
assign_sensor_modal.update_successful_note: This device definition has been updated.

sensors.detected_devices_desc: A list of all sensors & actuators detected by the controller.
sensors.no_fridge_warning: No fridge/chamber temperature sensor selected. No temperature control can take place.
sensors.no_beer_warning: No beer temperature sensor selected. Cannot use beer constant/profile control modes.
sensors.no_beer_warning_glycol: No beer temperature sensor selected. Glycol mode requires a beer sensor for temperature control.
sensors.no_relay_warning: Neither a heat or cool switch/relay is selected. No temperature control can take place.
sensors.no_heat_warning: No heat switch/relay is selected - temperature control will be cooling only.
sensors.no_cool_warning: No cooling switch/relay is selected - temperature control will be heating only.

upstream_settings.fermentrack_settings_desc: How this controller communicates with Fermentrack
upstream_settings.missing_data_error: There was data missing in the registration message which is typically set internally by the controller. This most likely means that either the controller firmware or the version of Fermentrack is out of date. Please update the controller firmware and/or Fermentrack and try again.
upstream_settings.invalid_username_error: Username is invalid on the targeted Fermentrack install. Please check the username and try again.
upstream_settings.bad_api_key_error: API Key does not match a valid brewhouse on the targeted Fermentrack install. Please enter a valid username and try again.
upstream_settings.missing_brewhouse_error: The specified Fermentrack user does not have a brewhouse. Please complete setup of this user in Fermentrack and try again.
upstream_settings.no_username_error: No username or API key specified.
upstream_settings.waiting_to_register_error: Device is waiting to register with Fermentrack. Please wait up to 3 minutes and refresh this page.
upstream_settings.registration_failed_error: Controller could not register with Fermentrack. Please verify that the hostname/port are correct, that Fermentrack is reachable, and that the username or API key is valid for the targeted Fermentrack install.
upstream_settings.successful_registration_msg: Controller is successfully registered with Fermentrack
upstream_settings.telnet_interface_unavailable: The telnet interface (for legacy Fermentrack/Brewpi-Remix) is disabled while registered with Fermentrack for REST control
upstream_settings.unknown error: An unknown error was sent by Fermentrack. This most likely means that either the controller firmware or the version of Fermentrack is out of date. Please update the controller firmware and/or Fermentrack and try again.
upstream_settings.reset_device_id_msg: Delete device ID and re-register with upstream. Warning - cannot be undone!
upstream_settings.hostname_too_long_error: Hostname is invalid. Must be less than 127 characters.
upstream_settings.port_out_of_range_error: Port number must be between 10 and 65535 (but is typically 80)

upstream_presets.legacy_fermentrack_desc: Use this controller with the legacy Fermentrack / Brewpi-Remix telnet interface
upstream_presets.fermentrack_net_desc: Use Fermentrack.net to control this controller
upstream_presets.fermentrack_local_desc: Use a local Fermentrack 2 instance (other than Fermentrack.net) to control this controller

extended_settings.glycol_mode_desc: (Modifies the controller to manage a glycol pump for temperature control rather than compressor-based cooling)
extended_settings.glycol_mode_warning: Enabling Glycol Mode will stop any active temperature control. You will need to set a new control mode after saving this setting.
extended_settings.glycol_cooling_algorithm_desc: Predictive coast anticipates cooling that continues after the pump stops. Pulse-dose learns how much cooling each pump run provides.
extended_settings.glycol_cooling_algorithm_switch: Save to apply your choice. If the pump is running, the change waits until it can safely turn off. Your temperature target stays the same.
extended_settings.save_failed: Settings could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
extended_settings.rotate_tft_desc: (Rotates a TFT display if it is currently upside-down)
extended_settings.reset_screen_on_pin_desc: (Resets the screen when a relay pin toggles - useful if the screen frequently freezes or gets corrupted)
extended_settings.low_delay_warning: Selecting "Low Delay" mode substantially reduces the delay in activating cooling, and may damage compressor-based cooling systems like refrigerators. If you are not confident that your setup will not be damaged, please do not select this mode.
extended_settings.custom_times_warning: The default minimum times are intended to help prevent damage to your heating/cooling systems. Reducing the delays may damage compressor-based cooling systems like refrigerators. Please do not select this mode unless you are confident taking the risk that your settings will not result in damage to your equipment.
extended_settings.min_cool_off_time_desc: Minimum amount of time (in seconds) that the cooling must remain off before turning on again
extended_settings.min_heat_off_time_desc: Minimum amount of time (in seconds) that the heating must remain off before turning on again
extended_settings.min_cool_on_time_desc: Minimum amount of time (in seconds) that the cooling must remain on before turning off again
extended_settings.min_heat_on_time_desc: Minimum amount of time (in seconds) that the heating must remain on before turning off again
extended_settings.min_cool_off_time_fridge_constant: Min Cool Off Time (Fridge Constant mode)
extended_settings.min_cool_off_time_fridge_constant_desc: Minimum amount of time (in seconds) that the cooling must remain off before turning on again when in "fridge constant" mode
extended_settings.min_switch_time_desc: Minimum amount of time (in seconds) to wait before switching from heating to cooling (or vice versa)
extended_settings.cool_peak_detect_time_desc: Maximum amount of time (in seconds) to wait while attempting to detect the "peak" temperature while cooling
extended_settings.heat_peak_detect_time_desc: Maximum amount of time (in seconds) to wait while attempting to detect the "peak" temperature while heating
extended_settings.set_defaults_desc: Default times, intended for compressor-based cooling
extended_settings.set_low_delay_desc: "Low Delay" mode, intended for non-compressor-based cooling
extended_settings.temperature_units_msg: Change the temperature units used by the controller

water_test.intro: Help improve BrewPi's glycol simulator using your own fermenter and cooling system.
water_test.stale_readings: Displayed values are the last known state, not live readings. Closing this page or losing WiFi does not stop a test.
water_test.active_help: The device runs the entire sequence. You may close this page. Stop may wait for the relay's minimum ON time before switching the pump off.
water_test.restored: Normal control has been restored using the saved mode and setpoints. Use the submission link below to view the recorded test temperatures.
water_test.reported_temperature: Glycol temperature not measured — using reported setpoint {temperature}.
water_test.unknown_temperature: Glycol temperature not measured — input unknown.
water_test.unmeasured_temperature: Glycol temperature is not being measured during this test.
water_test.upload_help: Keep BrewPi powered and connected to WiFi. It will retry automatically; you can close this page. Test completion and data delivery are separate.
water_test.view_results: View this device's submissions and simulator comparisons
water_test.processing: Processing may take a little longer. A stopped or inconclusive test can still be submitted successfully.
water_test.restore_setup: Restore your usual setup before resuming the saved mode and setpoints. No heater is used in this test.
water_test.probe_returned: I have returned the chamber probe to its normal location.
water_test.cannot_start: A new test is not available yet. Any pending submission is retained on the device.
water_test.prepare_title: Prepare once, then let the test run
water_test.prepare_water: Fill the fermenter with {water} at your usual batch volume. Keep the beer probe in its usual position.
water_test.prepare_circuit: Connect the normal glycol circuit and run your chiller at its usual setpoint. Leave the heater off.
water_test.prepare_nearby: Remain nearby for the first pump pulse so you can stop the test if the pump or circulation is not working.
water_test.sequence_help: BrewPi records a baseline, runs up to three bounded cooling pulses, and observes the response between pulses. Allow about 60–90 minutes; no reheating or temperature resets are needed. Control stays OFF when the test ends until you choose to resume it.
water_test.water_question: 2. How much water is in it for this test?
water_test.probe_question: 4. How is the beer probe installed?
water_test.chamber_question: 5. Can you place your existing chamber probe in the glycol bath?
water_test.probe_optional: Optional — you do not need to add a probe.
water_test.use_chamber_probe: Yes, use my chamber probe to measure the bath
water_test.chamber_unavailable: No usable chamber probe is currently available. You can use a reported setpoint below.
water_test.no_chamber_probe: No / I do not have a chamber probe
water_test.move_probe: Move the chamber probe into the glycol bath now. Its normal assignment will be preserved, and these readings will be recorded as glycol bath temperature during this test. Return it to its normal location before resuming control.
water_test.probe_immersed: The chamber probe is now immersed in the glycol bath, separate from the beer probe.
water_test.reported_setpoint: Glycol temperature not measured — using reported setpoint.
water_test.unknown_setpoint: I do not know the setpoint
water_test.unknown_setpoint_help: The glycol input will be marked unknown. This may limit the simulator comparison.
water_test.water_confirmation: My vessel contains water for this test, the heater is off, and the cooling circuit is ready.
water_test.consent: I agree to submit this test's setup answers, temperature readings, relay events, firmware details, and device GUID to chill.fermentrack.net to improve BrewPi's simulator. This records only this test, not ongoing brewing. The submission and setup answers can be viewed by anyone with the device's results link.
water_test.privacy: No account, additional logger, or manual upload is needed. WiFi passwords and upstream API keys are not part of the test data.
water_test.previous_results: View previous submissions for this device
water_test.title: Water test

phases.baseline: Recording the starting temperature and drift
phases.stopping: Stopping after the relay minimum ON time

reasons.no_measurable_response: The test finished without a clear cooling response.
reasons.beer_sensor_fault: The beer probe reported an error. The pump was switched off.
reasons.beer_sensor_stale: The beer probe stopped providing fresh readings. The pump was switched off.
reasons.temperature_limit: The water reached this test’s temperature-change limit.
reasons.runtime_limit: The test reached its maximum running time.
reasons.recording_failure: The device could not continue saving readings. Available data was retained.
reasons.sample_queue_overflow: The device could not keep up with recording. The test was stopped.
reasons.reboot_interrupted: A device restart interrupted the test. The pump sequence was not resumed.
reasons.recording_gap: Part of the recording is missing. The available data was retained.
reasons.relay_minimum_limit: The relay minimum times exceed this test’s pulse limits.
reasons.pump_time_limit: The test reached its total pump-time limit.
reasons.unexpected_output: An unexpected output state ended the test.

errors.command_unconfirmed: Unable to confirm the command. Check the device status before trying again.
errors.timeout: The device did not reply. The test may still be running; reconnect to check its state.
errors.unreadable: The device returned an unreadable water-test status.
errors.confirm_preparation: Confirm the water-only preparation and consent to submit this test.
errors.enter_water: Enter the amount of water in the fermenter.
errors.water_range: Water volume must be between 0.01 and 10,000 liters.
errors.capacity_range: Fermenter capacity must be between 0.01 and 10,000 liters.
errors.select_cooling: Select how the fermenter is cooled.
errors.select_probe: Select how the beer probe is installed.
errors.select_chamber: Select whether you can place a chamber probe in the glycol bath.
errors.confirm_probe: Confirm that the chamber probe is now in the glycol bath.
errors.enter_setpoint: Enter the chiller's setpoint, or select unknown.
errors.setpoint_range: Check the chiller setpoint and its units.
